changeHypothesis.summary: AI-related passive-component demand and price increases were real, but the economic incidence varied sharply. 三环集团 had strong Q1 revenue/profit acceleration and an analyst forecast reset, while 顺络电子's margins were hit by metals and 风华高科 grew more slowly. However, by Apr30 三环's price had effectively reached the newly raised analyst target and its valuation was already near a five-year extreme, so the company edge did not translate into a High-priority price-relative selection.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: TrendForce identified AI/consumer divergence and price hikes; company Q1 results showed large differences in actual margin/profit capture.
disconfirmingEvidence: Metal inflation can make price hikes merely cost pass-through rather than margin expansion.

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: Q1 was already labeled above expectations and analyst 2026/27 forecasts were raised from RMB3.288/3.890bn to RMB3.997/5.495bn.
